preferred_rationale: Matches the PAN description on the council portal ('300MW demand utility capacity') and all developer material.
notes: Described as 'demand utility capacity' in PAN TP/ED/25/0428; developer material calls it a '300MW AI data campus'. Not explicitly broken down into IT load vs total demand.

500MW BESS in containerised units across three battery areas; intended to be consented separately under section 36 via the Energy Consents Unit. ECU EIA screening reference EDC00006158; screening concluded EIA required (8 Jul 2025). No s36 application located as of 30 Jul 2026.

claimant: Scotland Data Centre Observatory (sum of building labels)
notes: Consultation masterplan labels the four data centre buildings 80MW + 64MW + 48MW + 48MW = 240MW, against the 300MW campus demand figure. Interpretation (IT load vs building demand) not stated by developer.
APRS page headline describes 'a 200MW data centre', inconsistent with the 300MW figure it also cites from the developer website; likely an error but preserved as a conflicting claim.
